name: a line of weeds growing along a crack with tiny wild flowers
label: wasteland_ruins/weeds-c
reasons: 화풍: 칸 정보량이 기준보다 훨씬 낮음 (4/4)

surfaces.part: weed clump along a diagonal crack, seen from above

answer.evidence: The object is a diagonal strip of weeds (rows 2-14, width 1-9 px) that lies flat on the ground. It has no vertical south face: the column scans show only a dark outline, leaf-green fill and a few flower pixels, with no front-edge line, eave shadow or separate front face. The silhouette widens and narrows smoothly, like a flat decal seen from above. This is the expected look for a flat kind, so the kind matches, and it reads as top-down with no front face.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tiny green sprite (a small diagonal bar, smaller than one 16x16 tile) with about 10 colours. It is not a 4x3-tile ground patch like the grass and paving references, so it does not show the requested kind. There is no ground surface, no crack, no weed line across tiles and no visible flowers. Its dark edge pixels are tinted dark green rather than neutral, which is fine. Visible tones per tile are 0 because the piece is smaller than a tile, so I judged by eye. By eye it shows only about 3 green steps and little texture, against the references' dense grass clumps and stone-by-stone paving. It carries far less information than either reference and reads as a sticker-like icon, not a tileable ground patch.
